statements.t: We intend to maintain this valuation allowance until sufficient positive evidence exists to support its reversal.
Our income tax expense recorded in the future will be reduced to the extent that sufficient positive evidence materializes to support a reversal of, or decrease in, our valuation allowance.

statements.t: The Company cannot reconcile its non-GAAP guidance to the most directly comparable GAAP measures without unreasonable efforts because it cannot reliably predict warrant fair value changes, which depend on its future stock price, or the timing and amount of restructuring charges, special project costs and stock-based compensation expense.

Following the conclusion of the live call, a replay of the webcast will be available on the Company's website at www.quantum.com for at least 90 days.

Non-GAAP adjusted operating expenses is a non-GAAP financial measure defined by us as GAAP operating expenses with stock-based compensation expense, restructuring charges, amortization of acquisition related intangible assets and other special project costs removed.

Non-GAAP adjusted EBITDA is defined by us as GAAP net income (loss) excluding interest expense, net, provision for income taxes, depreciation expense, amortization of acquisition-related intangible assets, stock-based compensation expense, restructuring charges, (gain) loss on debt extinguishment, change in fair value of warrant liabilities, change in fair value of convertible note and other special project costs.
Management uses these non-GAAP financial measures to evaluate operating performance and prepare internal budgets and forecasts.

risks.t: the following: risks related to the need to address the many challenges facing our business
our dependence on a limited number of large customers, including hyperscale customers, and the timing of their orders
risks associated with executing our strategy
the timing, execution and realization of anticipated benefits from our cost reduction and restructuring initiatives
the effective distribution of our products and delivery of our services
fluctuations in the fair value of our warrant liabilities, which may materially affect our GAAP results
the outcome of any legal proceedings, claims and disputes
risks related to our ability to implement and maintain effective internal control over financial reporting in the future
